scenario: Comparison operators are defined for Time per LTIM.5.1. `e.fired_at > f.fired_at` (Time > Time) compiles cleanly. Also pins LTIM.5.2: Time comparison operates on utc_us.
rules_ds:
schema Event scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    fired_at: Time mutable

rule r:
    Event e where e.entity_id == "a"
    Event f where f.entity_id == "b" and e.fired_at > f.fired_at
->
    log info "e is newer"
